map_policy: requirements.json and acceptance/ were written from the statement only and committed (stage-1 freeze, manifest.w.json) before any candidate, decoy or hidden test existed.
prompt: In roman.js (CommonJS), fix fromRoman(s) so that the module meets every requirement below. R1: fromRoman understands subtractive pairs IV 4, IX 9, XL 40, XC 90, CD 400 and CM 900, so fromRoman('MCMXCIV') === 1994. R2: fromRoman accepts only canonical numerals, i.e. exactly the strings toRoman returns for 1..3999; any other string of Roman letters (for example 'IIII', 'VV', 'IC', 'XM', 'IIV', 'MMMM', 'VX') throws RangeError. R3: fromRoman throws TypeError when its argument is not a string, and RangeError for '' or for any character other than the uppercase letters I V X L C D M (so lowercase 'iv' throws RangeError). R4: toRoman is unchanged: toRoman(1994) === 'MCMXCIV', toRoman(3999) === 'MMMCMXCIX', and 0, 4000 or 1.5 throw RangeError.
